title: vados 0.5.0 and skilj 0.3.0
subTitle: Two releases, a first day back at work and a walk home
summary: vados 0.5.0 clears part of what was on the horizon last time, and skilj 0.3.0 adds large payloads and a way to correct what was recorded. What each one changes, what this blog needed, and why the scope of skilj is the hard part.
